Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: huytuong010101
Message:
fix(google,cdp-worker): mark a connection as errored on a dead refresh token

Google's invalid_grant (revoked, or expired under a Testing-mode OAuth
consent screen's 7-day cap) previously just bubbled up as a generic
Error -- nothing marked the connection as broken, so the recurring
connector poll (added in the previous PR) would re-enqueue and re-fail
the exact same connection's ingest job every 15 minutes, forever, with
no signal anywhere telling the user to reconnect.

packages/google: refreshAccessToken now throws a distinguishable
GoogleInvalidGrantError specifically for error: "invalid_grant",
instead of an indistinguishable generic Error.

apps/cdp-worker: extracts the near-identical getTokens() duplicated
across google-calendar.ts/gmail.ts/google-drive.ts/google-contacts.ts
into one shared getGoogleTokens() (adapters/googleTokens.ts). On
GoogleInvalidGrantError, it now sets connection.status = 'error'
(already a valid value in the schema's CHECK constraint) before
rethrowing -- the poll job's own `WHERE status = 'active'` query then
naturally stops touching it, and GET /connections already surfaces
`status` to the frontend.

HubSpot/Slack/Jira use their own separate getTokens() with different
OAuth error shapes -- not covered here, same class of gap, tracked as
a follow-up.
